dedupe_keys.name: regional earthquake induced landslide assessments for evaluating seismic risk to critical infrastructure

description: Regional Earthquake-Induced Landslide Assessments for Evaluating Seismic Risk to Critical Infrastructure is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Ellen Rathje, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). In California, several thousands of kilometers of spatially distributed lifeline infrastructure, such as natural gas pipelines, power lines and transportation network, traverse regions that are susceptible to earthquake-induced landslides, creating a need for a state-wide seismic risk assessment of natural gas pipelines. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-94jv-8j27. Keywords: regional scale shear strength assignment, critical infrastructure seismic risk assessments, earthquake-induced landslides, logic tree analysis, geomorphic slope units, pipeline risk assessments. Published 2023-12-21. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
